candidate_store: All proposals including rejected and superseded revisions
confirmed_store: Only active approvals bound to proposal content, evidence and applicable source versions
candidate_exploration: Explicitly enabled and labeled as hypotheses; not factual retrieval
revision_rule: A revision creates a new proposal with parent_proposal_id; preserve old content and decisions

approval_requirements.actor: Authenticated human reviewer with server-checked permission; JSON actor_type alone is not authentication

review_methods.source_provenance: Official producer, source identity and dataset ID review
review_methods.indicator_definition: Terminology, units, denominator and age definition review
review_methods.metadata_mapping: Actual subseries, schema, codelist and scope review
review_methods.query_interpretation: Question scope and ambiguity review; not a scientific claim
review_methods.context_hypothesis: Domain rationale review; can establish exploration relevance, not statistical association
review_methods.join_candidate: Key uniqueness, cardinality, join coverage, units and time/spatial alignment
review_methods.statistical_association: Reproducible scoped analysis and human interpretation of uncertainty

model_json_role: Generated view of the review ledger; never direct AI approval output

delivery.large_job_profile: Not enabled; requires separate workers, quota and explicit job budget

community.default_upload: Source links, reproducible recipes and reviewed small examples
